## DERMATOLOGY SERVICE ORDER MENU FOR RECALCITRANT ACNE AND ROSACEA
## **For dermatology use only, requires dermatology consult prior to treatment**
## Recalcitrant Acne and Rosacea Treatment:
[Trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) [R,DI] for 12 weeks](psjzid2-tmp-sulfa-12wks-1ds-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 500/125 mg PO BID ($) [R] for 12 weeks](psjzid2-amox-clav-500-125mg-12wks-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Azithromycin 500 mg three times weekly ($) [O] for 12 weeks](psjzid2-azithromycin-12wks-500mg-po-3x-week)
## Refractory Severe Rosacea Treatment:
[Doxycycline 50 mg PO BID ($) [DI] prolonged therapy](psjzid-doxycycline-50mg-po-q12h)
